title: Expose the public home login link

evidence: FT-001-AC-012 / REQ-001: SSR and source smoke show the public `/` page renders a visible ordinary anchor `Вход` with focus-visible styling; no imperative `/login` navigation or authentication action is present.

Implementer evidence and independent reviewer evidence both PASS: SSR GET / returned 200, exactly one href=/login Вход anchor was observed, the fixture remained preserved, full tests passed 117/117, focused checks passed 38/38, npm run check/build and git diff --check passed, and forbidden authentication paths were untouched.
SSR GET / returned HTTP 200 and exactly one ordinary href=/login anchor with visible text Вход; the fixture calendar remained preserved.
Full test suite 117/117 and focused checks 38/38 passed; npm run check, npm run build, and git diff --check passed; forbidden auth paths remained untouched.

verify.accepted_evidence: The explicit top-level owner accepted the Implementer PASS and independent Reviewer PASS for the bounded T1 outcome and requested this task-boundary sync.
verify.accepted_residual_risk: FT-001 remains planned because remaining product/UI outcomes are not covered by this single public login-entry task.

purpose: Make the existing browser login route discoverable from the public landing page without widening the authentication surface.
success_outcome: The public `/` page visibly exposes an accessible `Вход` anchor whose exact href is `/login`; activating it only navigates to the existing login page.
anti_goals: Do not replace, remove, or make database-backed the public calendar fixture; FT-003 owns that separate product outcome.
Do not change `/login`, provider routes, hooks, Identity & Access, sessions, cookies, role routing, authorization, or persistence.
Do not add a dependency, dashboard, new route, redirect, client-owned authorization state, or authentication UI beyond the one ordinary anchor.

stop_conditions: Stop if the visible CTA requires any session, provider, account, role, cookie, hook, server-load, or redirect change.
Stop if implementation requires replacing the public calendar fixture or adding a class/dashboard/calendar navigation path; those belong to FT-003 planning.
Stop if the page cannot use an ordinary accessible anchor with exact href `/login`.

constraints: Use the existing Svelte 5 runes component and an ordinary declarative `<a href="/login">` link; do not add imperative navigation for this link.
Keep the existing public calendar content and its current date-navigation behavior intact.
The CTA is presentation-only and cannot read or mutate session, provider, account, role, cookie, or persistence state.
invariants: `/` remains public and contains a visible, keyboard-reachable `Вход` link with exact href `/login`.
Following the CTA changes no authentication or authorization state before the existing `/login` behavior begins.
The calendar fixture remains an FT-003-owned scope exclusion for this task.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-012 / REQ-001: SSR/source smoke renders visible `Вход` text in an anchor with exact href `/login`; the focused test also proves the link is not a form control, redirect, or script-generated auth action.
Regression: existing calendar date navigation and existing login/provider/session test suites remain green; source/diff review confirms no change outside the two hard-boundary files.
